scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Take up Value Addition to Seafood
other_conditions: Applicant must be an individual interested in setting up a unit for value‑added fisheries products
Applicant must have been a resident of Goa for the last 15 years
Preference given to self‑help groups, women entrepreneurs, and youth who have completed fishermen training courses or short‑term training programs conducted by the Directorate of Fisheries
benefits_summary: Provides a 50% subsidy up to ₹5,00,000 for construction/renovation and up to ₹2,00,000 for equipment purchase.
